messages:
oncall-bot: PAGER — INCIDENT INC-2026-042: elevated queueing and 429s on runtime-prod (severity P2). paging @Maya @Alex @Priya. dashboard: https://dash.redwood/internal/incidents/INC-2026-042 :rotating_light:
Maya: I'm on it. quick snapshot: runtime-prod node pool us-west-2 showing steady climb in in-flight requests per worker, p99 latency spiking to ~12s, 5xx and 429s increasing. logs show long token-decode stalls and some requests stuck in KV-cache waits.
Alex: Confirmed on dashboards — mean inflight/host 48 (was ~12), queue depth per host 4x. gateway returning 429s for non-enterprise clients.
Priya: Affected customers: AcmeCorp (enterprise), BetaApp (mid-market), a handful of free-tier apps. AcmeCorp is on high-priority support — we should avoid service interruption for them.
Maya: Proposed live mitigations to reduce immediate impact (order-of-ops):
  1) Canary: reduce runtime pool `max_in_flight` from 64 -> 32 (canary 2 hosts) to limit head-of-line blocking.
  2) Enable shedding for low-priority routes (embeddings/rerank) with aggressive drop fraction.
  3) Temporarily bump quota for AcmeCorp and route them to dedicated lane.
  4) Shorten generation timeouts from 30s -> 12s to free hung workers.
  5) Disable experimental `streaming-fastpath` on runtime-prod if canary shows regressions.
Sam: Sounds reasonable. can you post the commands you plan to run? I'll monitor logs/alerts.
Maya: running canary change now. commands I'm using (internal control plane):
```
# reduce max_in_flight for canary hosts
curl -s -X POST https://controlplane.internal/api/pools/runtime-prod/config 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $CTRL_TOKEN" 
  -d '{"max_in_flight":32, "target_nodes": {"role":"canary","count":2}}'

# enable shedding rule for embedding routes (drop 80% low-pri)
curl -s -X POST https://controlplane.internal/api/policies/shedding 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $CTRL_TOKEN" 
  -d '{"match":"route:embedding*","priority":"low","drop_fraction":0.8, "enabled":true}'

# shorten generation timeouts
curl -s -X POST https://controlplane.internal/api/route/config 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $CTRL_TOKEN" 
  -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","timeout_ms":12000}'
```
Alex: Nice — apply to canary first. use `?canary=2` on those endpoints. watch batcher logs for dropped batches. I'll keep an eye on autoscaler and node CPU.
engops-bot: Deploy started: runtime-prod config update (canary=2). build-id: bld_2026_042_89.
Maya: Canary results after 60s: canary hosts show queue depth down ~65%, no increase in error rate on canary, p99 latency down to ~3s on canary. proceeding with gradual rollout across pool (10 -> 30 -> 100%).
Priya: I'm notifying AcmeCorp SOC and support channel. telling them we applied temporary quota bump + routing to dedicated lane. drafting customer note now.
Maya: Rolling to next cohort (30%). metrics look stable. initiating shedding globally for matching low-pri routes now.
engops-bot: Shedding policy applied globally.
Alex: Observed overall 5xx rate drop from 7% -> 1.4%, gateway 429s down 70%, overall queue depth down 60%. Good signal.
Priya: Customer update posted to AcmeCorp and BetaApp. AcmeCorp support asks for ETA on root cause. I'll say we're in mitigation and will follow up with postmortem.
Maya: Notes on temporary changes (for postmortem):
- max_in_flight lowered 64->32 across runtime-prod (temporary).
- shedding enabled for embedding/rerank routes with drop_fraction 0.8 (low-priority).
- generation route timeout reduced 30s->12s.
- streaming-fastpath toggled off on canary during validation (not rolled global unless needed).
Sam: Taking over on-call from here — I'll continue monitoring and start a slow rollback plan only after sustained stability (2h). Maya — any handoff notes?
Maya: Handoff: I'm off in 30m. follow-ups: schedule batcher tuning (reduce max batch size for long-context requests), investigate decoder stalls in recent model bundle (may be model-induced), correlate with recent model rollout 2026-04-01 v3.2.1. logs location: https://logs.redwood/internal/streams/INC-2026-042.
Sam: Ack. I'll keep pages open and escalate if error rate >2% or p99 >6s. also opening a ticket to engineering-research for perf regression on v3.2.1.
Priya: Support notified affected customers, added temporary quota entries for AcmeCorp (quota_id q_822). Created advisory: https://support.redwood/incidents/INC-2026-042.
Alex: Quick reminder: revert shedding and timeouts carefully — they impact costs and correctness. plan a staged revert after root cause and perf fix.
Maya: Thanks team :thumbsup: I'm signing off. Sam, ping me if you need the control-plane creds; leaving a short runbook in the incident channel.
Sam: Will do. thanks Maya. I'll post a summary update every 30m and kick off postmortem draft once stable. :eyes:
